EDUCATION
Western Illinois University, Macomb, IL
Bachelor of Science in Biology, expected May 2027
Minor: Chemistry
Relevant Courses: General Biology I and II, Genetics, Cell Biology, Organic Chemistry I and II, Microbiology, Statistics for Life Sciences

RESEARCH EXPERIENCE
Undergraduate Research Assistant, Department of Biological Sciences, Western Illinois University
April 2026 – Present
• Assist graduate students with experiments in a plant molecular biology lab.
• Prepare growth media, agar plates, and buffer solutions for the lab.
• Maintain Arabidopsis plant lines in the growth chamber and record watering and growth data.
• Help with DNA extractions and run PCR and gel electrophoresis under supervision.
• Attend weekly lab meetings and journal club; presented one paper summary to the lab in September 2026.
• Keep a lab notebook and clean and organize shared lab equipment.
• Help with autoclaving, glassware, and ordering supplies when the lab manager is out.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Sales Associate, Walmart, Macomb, IL
August 2024 – Present (part-time, 15–20 hours per week)
• Help customers find products and answer questions.
• Stock shelves and keep the department organized.
• Operate the register and handle returns.

Camp Counselor, Spring Lake Park District Summer Camp, Macomb, IL
June 2025 – August 2025
• Supervised groups of children ages 8 to 11 during daily activities.
• Led outdoor games and science-themed crafts.

ACTIVITIES
Pre-Health Society, Western Illinois University — Member, 2024 – Present
• Attend monthly meetings and guest speaker events.
• Volunteered at the society's annual blood drive.

Biology Club — Member, 2025 – Present

Volunteer, McDonough District Hospital — 2025 (about 40 hours)
• Greeted visitors and delivered items to patient rooms.
• Shadowed a nurse practitioner for two shifts in the outpatient clinic.

SKILLS
Laboratory: pipetting, media preparation, PCR, gel electrophoresis, aseptic technique, light microscopy
Computer: Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, basic R from statistics course
Other: CPR and First Aid certified (2025), Spanish (basic)
